input_unit: one canonical source document row; no duplicated purpose corpus
candidate_pool: all 789 BOK RAG rows for recall measurement; approved and needs_review reported separately

gold_label_definition.approved: human confirms the document materially teaches the target chapter/concept and evidence is sufficient
gold_label_definition.needs_review: human cannot decide without additional context, source verification, or curriculum mapping
gold_label_definition.irrelevant: document is not materially relevant to the target chapter/concept; incidental keyword is insufficient

keyword_only.input: normalized term/title/definition/content plus versioned keyword and exclusion lists
keyword_only.known_limitation: current baseline marks many incidental mentions as DIRECT; it is a candidate generator, not ground truth

llm_only.input: same source row plus chapter learning goal and output schema
llm_only.output: label, confidence, rationale, evidence_quote, document_id, model_version
llm_only.required_guard: JSON schema validation, evidence quote must be contained in source content, retry/abstain on invalid output

hybrid.input: keyword candidates and exclusions followed by LLM review of ambiguous rows
hybrid.output: final candidate label, method_trace, evidence, confidence, reviewer_status
recommended_order: high-precision exact term and exclusion rules
human review for all approved mappings before operational use

evaluation.unit: document_id, grouped by source_id and chapter mapping
evaluation.split_policy: human-labeled stratified train/dev/test; do not leak duplicate content_hash across splits
evaluation.threshold_policy: choose approval threshold on dev set; report test metrics and confidence intervals
evaluation.missing_gold_behavior: NOT_EVALUATED; candidate labels must never be treated as gold

minimum_gold_set.recommendation: label all pilot candidates before comparing methods
minimum_gold_set.double_review: at least two reviewers for disagreements and a documented adjudication decision
